messages:
sanjay: Heads up — since the VPC egress tightening last night + the KMS key rotation, several prod GPU warm-pool nodes fail to join. Keystore decrypts timing out (~2m) and nodes stall on join. Sample log:
```
2026-03-20T04:12:07Z node-init ERROR keystore decrypt failed after 120s: timeout talking to keystore proxy (504)
2026-03-20T04:12:08Z warmup INFO join attempt 3 -> backoff
```
We see this in eu-west and us-east warm pools. Not an application regression — infra/networking/auth combo.

maya: seeing same in eu-west-1, natgw conntrack spikes and auditshipper S3 PUTs went nuts after the rotation :eyes:

dmitri: KMS rotated key id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:alias/keystore-main at 03:00 UTC. Keystore proxy got a burst of 403/5xx while rekeying sessions, might coincide with egress policy being narrower for privatelink endpoints.

jen: Confirmed — the new firewall policy allowed only specific privatelink endpoints, but keystore clients use ephemeral ENIs/addresses that weren't added to the allowlist. We intentionally avoided broadening egress because of compliance.

ops-bot: ALERT: keystore-decrypt-latency > 90s (10m window) — impacting node joins and autoscaler warmup.

kevin: Proposed mitigation:
- add temporary SG outbound rule allowing keystore ENI CIDR range (narrow) or allow privatelink service name for keystore
- increase warm-pool desired by +2 per region for 1 hour to avoid immediate capacity loss
- flip auditshipper to 20% sampling to reduce egress and S3 PUT spikes
Rough cost delta: extra warm nodes (~g4dn-equivalent) ~ $7k/day/region; sampling reduces S3 and egress costs ~ -$5k/day -> net +$2k/day (short window)

sanjay: Prefer minimal blast radius: add SG rule scoped to keystore-subnet CIDRs + specific destination ports (443) and add a route to privatelink endpoints where possible. If we must, we can fallback to rolling-back the firewall change but that's last resort.

maya: AWS CLI snippet to add SG egress for privatelink ENIs (will scope to keystore ENI tag):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.199.0.0/22 --description "temp allow keystore privatelink"
```
I'll bake this into a small ops runbook and run it after the PR is merged.

dmitri: I'll open a terraform PR to add keystore to egress-allowlist with a short TTL and include a note linking to the KMS rotation runbook. PR will include an emergency revert checkbox.

jen: Sounds good. I'll hold off on rolling back the egress policy. Plan: SG change + sampling + warm-pool bump. If latency doesn't recover in 30m then we revert policy.

ops-bot: deployment started: audit-sampler v2 -> sampling=20% (deploy id deploy-kg-442)

kevin: I've triggered warmpool scale +2 in eu-west and us-east for 30m. Monitoring added to the gpu-warmup dashboard.

sanjay: Update 25m in: nodes are joining again, keystore decrypts ~200ms now, warm-pool stable. Audit PUTs trending down after sampler flip. Leaving the thread open for 1h to ensure no regression. Thanks all :thumbsup:
